basic_details.organization_name: Sardar Vallabhbhai National Institute of Technology Surat (SVNIT)
basic_details.short_information: Sardar Vallabhbhai National Institute of Technology Surat (SVNIT) has published the Senior Urban Planner Notification 2026 on its official website, https://www.svnit.ac.in/. The recruitment drive aims to fill 1 Senior Urban Planner position. Candidates possessing a B.E./ B.Tech. (Civil) or B.Arch. with M.E./ M.Tech./ M.Plan or an equivalent postgraduate degree in the relevant planning or transportation disciplines, along with GATE/CSIR-UGC NET qualification and two years of post-graduation experience, are eligible to attend the walk-in interview on 10 August 2026. qualification.details: Senior Urban Planner: B.E. / B.Tech. (Civil)/ B. Arch with M.E. / M.Tech/ M.Plan (Urban Planning/ Urban Design/ Transport Planning/ Transportation Engineering & Planning / Highway & Transportation Engineering / Transportation Engineering). Any PG degree like MURP, M Design, Planning, MCP etc from reputed Institute will be considered equivalent to M.E/ M.Tech/ M Plan. Candidate must have qualified GATE CSIR UGC NET and having 2 Years of experience after Post Graduation. Candidate must have knowledge of Climate Resilience Planning, Knowledge of Software like, GIS, and other to perform the studies related to Big Data Analytics and Heat Island identification.

SVNIT Senior Urban Planner Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for SVNIT Senior Urban Planner Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the post name for SVNIT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The post name for the SVNIT Recruitment 2026 is Senior Urban Planner. This is a contract-based position.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Senior Urban Planner post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Senior Urban Planner post at SVNIT Surat.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is Walk-in. Candidates need to attend the interview directly.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Senior Urban Planner position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Senior Urban Planner position will receive a salary of Rs. 42,000 Per Month.

faq.question: Q5. What are the educational qualifications required for the Senior Urban Planner post?
faq.answer: Candidates need a B.E./B.Tech. (Civil)/B. Arch with M.E./M.Tech/M.Plan in relevant fields and must have qualified GATE CSIR UGC NET with 2 years of post-graduation experience.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. When is the Walk-in Interview scheduled?
faq.answer: The Walk-in Interview for the Senior Urban Planner post is scheduled for 10 August 2026.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should I carry for the Walk-in Interview?
faq.answer: You should carry all original documents, one set of self-attested photocopies, ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates, and category certificates if applicable.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process includes a Walk-in Interview and Document Verification.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the Walk-in Interview venue?
faq.answer: The specific venue details for the Walk-in Interview will be available in the official notification PDF.
